items.text: Agree a meeting point for the household if you cannot get home or have to leave.
Everyone knows where the water and electricity shut-offs are and how to use them.
Copy important documents on paper and in an encrypted file, kept apart from the originals.
A grab bag packed for each person: water, snacks, torch, radio, medication, a power bank, copies of key documents.
Take a first aid course and refresh it.
Plan how you would filter or boil water from the butt, and keep the butt clean.
Have an emergency power supply (EPS) fitted so solar or the home battery keeps working in a power cut.
Swap phone numbers with your neighbours and know who may need help.
Plan for your pets: food, water, carriers, vaccination records and somewhere that takes them.
Write down 999 or 112 and your local emergency numbers (power, water, gas, council) where everyone can find them.
